copy.headline: 90-year-old mowing lawns to get by
copy.caption:
Fort Worth, this one's for you 💜

90-year-old mowing lawns to get by in South Fort Worth sparks community support

“I see him walking up my driveway with the cane and just barely moving baby steps up the driveway; he could hardly even push the lawnmower," Clarissa Calderon said.

📍 Fort Worth, TX

Follow @FortWorthTexasTV for more 📲
